policy_name: Major Home Appliances Comprehensive Protection Policy
start_conditions: Commences upon certified delivery and verified technician installation date.
repair_conditions: On-site diagnostic inspection by certified brand technician required prior to part dispatch.
replacement_conditions: Sealed system compressor failure within 180 days entitles claimant to replacement compressor assembly with extended seal warranty.
hard_fail_rules: Appliance operated beyond residential domestic parameters
Severe rust or chemical corrosion caused by harsh industrial detergents
Electrical motor burnout resulting from ungrounded high-voltage power lines
Attempted compressor repair or gas refilling by unauthorized local mechanic
warning_rules: Multiple service visits logged for cooling or vibration within 90 days
Installation certificate submitted without technician signature stamp
Claim submitted in the second year with no routine filter maintenance logged
manual_review_rules: Conflict between customer reported failure date and telemetry log
Document hash matches an existing processed claim record in another household
Model consistency status is Weak Match or Model Disagreement
